archetype: ARCHETYPE 4 (SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST / JURIDICAL COMMAND CENTER) blended with ARCHETYPE 1 (WARM STONE & ARCHIVAL TERRACOTTA)
concept_narrative: A hyper-rigorous institutional legal-tech platform tailored for Italian public-private cultural heritage partnerships (PPP) and contentious administrative disputes. Melds Italian archival rigor (warm stone, antique marble, terracotta alerts) with high-density Swiss legal engineering (monochrome slate, deep navy, strict 1px grid borders, live multi-agent bus telemetries).

theme_strategy.rationale: Legal drafting, TAR judicial appeals, Corte dei Conti audits, and administrative scrutiny mandate maximum optical contrast and legibility without eye fatigue. An optional dark mode toggle ('Archival Night') is supported.

component_guidelines.buttons: Pill or subtle 6px radius, hover states with explicit text colors (e.g., bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white font-medium px-4 py-2 text-sm shadow-xs transition-colors duration-150)
component_guidelines.cards: Subtle borders border-slate-200 bg-white rounded-lg p-6 shadow-[0_1px_2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.03)]
component_guidelines.modals_and_drawers: Sheet/Dialog with solid high opacity background (bg-white or bg-slate-900), no see-through transparent overlays, crystal glass scrim backdrop-blur-sm bg-slate-900/40
component_guidelines.tables: Dense, clean tabular presentation with hover highlight on rows, monospaced dates and monetary values aligned right
component_guidelines.alerts: Institutional colored left-border callouts with legal citation references (e.g., 'Art. 21-quinquies L. 241/90')

testing_attributes.rule: Every button, link, tab trigger, input, select, download trigger, and modal trigger MUST include data-testid with kebab-case role naming

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-grade, ultra-sophisticated Single Page App with tabbed views or React Router for the JUS-PATRIMONIUM platform in React .js.
Implement the full 5-agent Cluster A workflow with an interactive Orchestration Bus visualizer: show agent message passing, prompt reflections, confidence scores, and legal citation linkages.
Include a live Procedural Risk Radar / Heatmap (e.g. Scadenza termini ricorso TAR 60gg, decadenza PNRR, silenzio inadempimento, periculum in mora).

Provide interactive Document Generation with realistic, authentic Italian administrative and legal templates (Ricorso TAR Lazio/Regionale con istanza cautelare, Diffida ad Adempiere ex art. 1454 c.c., Segnalazione Procura Regionale Corte dei Conti per danno erariale, Memorie difensive su preavviso di diniego/revoca ex art. 10-bis).

Provide real functional export: Client-side PDF generation (using window.print or jsPDF/blob styling) and DOCX generation / formatted rich text document download with timestamps and digital protocol simulation.

Include Document Ingestion with preset test legal acts (e.g. 'Delibera Comunale n. 42_2024 Revoca Concessione Chiostro San Francesco.pdf', 'Convenzione Partenariato Speciale PSPP art 151.docx') ready for one-click analysis.
Include the Damage & Restitution Quantifier interactive table with breakdown (Danno Patrimoniale, Investimenti non ammortizzati, Danno di immagine al Terzo Settore, Oneri di custodia bene vincolato).
Implement the Evolutionary Memory Vault with inspectable JSONL logs, vector search query tester, and self-learning reflection logs.
Integrate Sonner toast notifications for all system events (e.g., 'Agente Administrative Auditor: rilevata violazione art. 3 L. 241/90 motivazione per relationem viziata').
Ensure every interactive element has a rigorous data-testid attribute for automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use dark colors as gradients. Maintain clean structural contrast.
Never center-align the main application container; preserve clear left-aligned hierarchical reading.
Do not use emojis as tech icons; use Lucide React icons exclusively.
Never use generic transparent dropdowns or unstyled alerts.
Use generous spacing (p-6, p-8) on cards and layout containers to allow institutional content to breathe.
Ensure all text meets APCA / WCAG AA contrast standards over light backgrounds.
